trap.label: tempo verbal
trap.wrong: By 2030 we plant a million trees.
trap.right: By 2030 we will have planted a million trees.
trap.why: Português usa presente ou futuro simples. Ação concluída antes de um momento futuro pede will have + particípio.

mcq.q: By 2030 we **___** planted a million trees.

fix.right: By May they will have finished.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “By 2030 we plant a million trees.” (will have)
rewrite.answer: By 2030 we will have planted a million trees.
